description: Defines the 'Networks' class and related nested classes for managing broadcast network information, including scanning, parsing DVB network tables, and maintaining network data structures.

classes.name: Networks
classes.description: Manages DVB network scanning, parsing, and storage, including handling tuner notifications and network data.

classes.name: Networks::Network
classes.description: Represents a DVB network with properties like network ID, frequency, modulation, and name.

classes.name: Networks::Sink
classes.description: Implements tuner notification callbacks for network management.

classes.name: Networks::Parser
classes.description: Handles parsing DVB network information sections from tuner data streams.

methods.name: Networks::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for networks.

methods.name: Networks::List
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the list of networks.

methods.name: Networks::StateChange
methods.description: Handles tuner state changes to manage scanning.

methods.name: Networks::Load
methods.description: Loads network data from DVB NIT tables.
